“There’s been a ton of break-ins recently.. I’m kind of worried about it, you should be careful..” 

Phainon moved his cup of coffee to his lips over that, a hand lazily behind him to prop himself up on the counter as he stared at his co-worker. Tasting that bitter yet addicting fuel that kept him going on his tongue before flashing her a soft smile.

“It’s alright! I’m pretty secure in my home!” Phainon promised, which was an easy thing to do as he drooped his eyes back down to his mug - always choosing carefully when to take his allotted break time.

After all, It was the only time he got to see that cute lion-hybrid during working hours.

His eyes moved upwards, ignoring his co-worker at his side to instead focus on that man - golden tufted hair that looked like he truly had a lion’s mane that burst into flames at the ends of it. Golden eyes that always seemed strong and sturdy, calm and unwavering in a way that made Phainon’s chest curl with want.

.. All while he never once seemed to look at Phainon’s way for too long.

That was okay! Phainon couldn’t blame him, not really. Not when their office split up predator and prey hybrids, and well.. Phainon was unfortunate enough to be a bunny hybrid.

Phainon had perfected this routine, anyway - he would sit beside the coffee machine, idly watch the lion make his cup of coffee, chuckle to himself as the man made it more milk than coffee, and then. Like always, he would look at that lion with glittering eyes when he had to pause beside Phainon at the counter for creamer.

“Hello Mydeimos!”

Those words were always the thing that made Mydei move his eyes to meet Phainon’s own - a gorgeous sight, really. 

Fiery golden crimson, a depth of gold that looked as if it was still being melted down to pool into a puddle - all to form Mydei’s eyes that were sharp and studious. Yet.. Never hunting.

He never looked at Phainon as if he were prey, only always looking at him curiously - probably wondering why a bunny kept wanting his attention on the daily when those little tufted ears flicked over his name being said as well.

“Hello,” Mydei replied, as dry and flat as ever - but honestly, Phainon had grown used to that. Only able to beam a smile at the giant lion who was still slightly shorter than him - though, Phainon knew fully well he also was just extremely tall. 

“Did you hear about the recent break-ins? If you need a bunny to hide behind, I know a guy,” Phainon teased with a little wink - watching the way his co-worker from earlier gasped and moved away just a bit.

A normal occurrence, for some reason, predators still didn’t befriend prey in society, nor was it openly talked about.

.. Phainon wanted more than friendship with this lion, however.

“My hero,” Mydei’s reply gave nothing away as that lion turned away just a tad - enough to look away and at anything but Phainon as he raised his ‘coffee’ up to his lips to take a swig of it.

This was always something Phainon adored to watch, the daily rhythm of Mydei testing his coffee, tongue sliding over his lips in a hypnotizing fashion to the eager bunny who merely watched. Just as Mydei once again as always decided it needed more creamer and moved back closer to Phainon. Shoulders always just almost touching, and that was enough to give Phainon goosebumps every single time.

There were a lot of things about Mydei that had mystified Phainon to the point of being borderline obsessed with the lion hybrid.

For one: That sweet tooth of his he apparently had. Such a well toned and buff lion that clearly worked out and cared for his health, yet he always put too much sugar and cream into his coffee - only to follow it up with more sweets during his lunch break that Phainon keenly watched him eat. 

Second: He didn’t seem interested in anything, or anyone, not even prey. Not even when Phainon had purposefully rubbed into Mydei and tried his best to make Mydei drool over him - only for the lion to raise a brow at him curiously, and take a step away for distance, not batting an eye over the attempt.

Third: His little habits. Outside of the obvious oddity where Mydei’s tail stayed wrapped around his own leg, there were other ones. The cute ones where he would grab his own braid and play with it, the ones where he would tilt his head over some words being said to him with soft eyes. The way his left ear atop his head would flick a little every time someone said his name..

It all made Phainon think that man was much too cute, adorable, really. 

So adorable, that Phainon just wanted to gently cradle that tail around his hand - wrapping it around himself before yanking it to hear what kind of noises that lion would make at him over it. 

“Really though, are predators like yourself worried over it?” Phainon asked innocently, watching the way Mydei was still pouring in more creamer before he tilted his head - just like he always did when he was puzzled over his own reply he desired to say.

“Not particularly, there’s been nothing stolen or anyone hurt,” Mydei mumbled as he turned a little - enough to copy Phainon and lazily lean on the break room counter. A move that always made Phainon hear his own heart beat heavy in his ears - thunderous and loud, and he could only pray Mydei didn’t hear it as well and assume it was fear.

If anything, Phainon fully knew it was his own instincts of wanting to embrace his desire to breed as a rabbit with this man. Aching to have that large lion beneath him and writhing on the bed.. And all he could do was opt for small talk and yearn.

“Though, that does make it seem like they’re looking for someone,” Mydei added after a few moments - moving to take another sip of his drink while his eyes only moved elsewhere, always on alert.

And that was annoying.

Annoying, because Phainon most certainly had been looking for someone in particular every time he broke into someone’s house: Mydeimos. 

Three times now he had thought it to be his home, only to find the wrong person there and leave immediately.. It was enough to make Phainon smack his foot into the floor in annoyance - but he did his best not to as he gave a hum of acknowledgement. 

“That’s scary.. Maybe I need a big strong lion to protect me, then?” Phainon asked in a tease, yet feeling a little bit hopeful - if he could somehow get that man into his home, it would eliminate a lot of his issues, truly. 

Just for Mydei to give him a quick once over, before scoffing and shaking his head - a bad sign that Mydei was not buying into his cute little flirts currently, “.. You look plenty strong to me already.”

Phainon moved a hand to his chest, pressing there with a beaming smile as he felt his tiny fluffy tail wag just the tiniest bit over Mydei complimenting him, “Do I? Mydeimos, you flatter me!”

Mydei stared at him for a moment, letting the silence fall upon them both before moving his cup to his lips again while his sharp eyes moved away once more - slitted pupils never widening with his own thoughts to give anything away.

That was enough to drive Phainon insane as well. He could usually tell with people how they felt about him, how much they wanted him or hated him - yet this lion refused to break his stoicness often. Refused to let his own guard down, even for an innocent little rabbit. 

“Mhm.” That was all Mydei had to offer as he seemed to chug more of his coffee down - hand moving to grab at his own braided hair at the side of his head like he always did so painfully cutely. 

An action that gave away he was in thought as thick brows became knitted together, scrunched up in a way that made Phainon wish so desperately he could know what the man was thinking about - yet, once again, all he could was yearn over the lion that was gazing at nothing in specific. 

“Phainon, you need to be more worried for yourself!” 

That was bothersome, a voice at his side that made him snap out of his thoughts of lust for the lion who was standing close to him - instead dragging his eyes to look at the mouse hybrid at his side. The one he was talking to before, sure, but not a co-worker he cared to talk to right now, not when Mydei was there.

Not when he could feel those golden eyes burning into him, watching his every move - so closely that Phainon felt his heart pounding with the adrenaline of being watched by the predator. Keenly stared at, only praying it was the man finally debating to hunt him down, an action that Phainon would enjoy to flip on its head - ruin Mydei’s perception of the food chain and dominate that pretty hybrid.

.. But for now, he had to beam a smile at his co-worker, “I’m not overly worried, I don’t think any predators are hunting me right now.” 

Phainon practically purred out his words - watching the way her eyes nervously moved to Mydei, a gaze that made Phainon look away from her. Not directly to the lion, no, but enough to watch the way Mydei didn’t even look at them both, appearing as if he was determined to remain in his own lane and not step over.

Annoyingly.

“Just.. Be careful.. You don’t always know a person’s true self, alright?” That mouse only continued, and that was enough to make Phainon click his tongue behind his lips - never betraying his happy smile, even if that irked him insanely so.

She clearly was hinting towards Mydei being a threat, and was trying to make the lion feel uncomfortable - and the worst part was how Mydei had shuffled a little, obviously taking the hint as well. 

Phainon had to do his best to laugh at that - trying to disarm the bomb that had assuredly been placed by this mouse for Mydei to detonate, “Oh? I guess that’s true! Mydei has no idea I’m actually the predator in this friendship.”

“.. Friendship?” Mydei asked after a beat of silence, making Phainon stare and study the man - trying his best to not show how crushed that questioned out word made him feel.

“Are we not friends?” Phainon asked with a laugh, doing his best to try to hide the actual hurt that was creeping into his throat and threatening to choke him - unable to hold back a harsh bark of laughter as he shook his head, “You wound me!” 

He hoped it came off as a joke, a little jest between them both - but all Phainon felt now was oddly numb, hurt even, as he debated going to the restroom and hacking up everything in his stomach regardless. 

Just for Mydei to finally push away from that counter with a shake of his head, “.. Have a good day, you two.”

And that was how it always went - that lion would walk away from him and leave Phainon standing there to watch him go, eyes always taking in the sight of how his dress shirt seemed to struggle against his biceps yet his tail cutely wrapped around his own leg..

“He’s a nice lion, you know?” Phainon told her with a cold laugh leaving his  throat as he slid his eyes to look at that mouse again - tilting his head over the way his breaktime with Mydei had been cut short today due to her snarky remarks. 

“He’s a lion,” She told him, as if Phainon was supposed to care about that - instead, all he did was keep that lop-sided smile plastered on his lips to the best of his ability. Feeling uncomfortable in his own skin as he moved his eyes a little to look at where that ‘predator’ had walked off to. Back to work, anything but staying with Phainon and their idle chit-chat, anything but finishing his entire breaktime in the room made for such a thing. 

Phainon couldn’t figure out what mood he himself was in, either - instead bringing his coffee up to his lips and taking a slow sip of it with his eyes moving back to that mouse.

Annoyance towards her? Assuredly, but towards Mydei..? He still could only feel that lingering emotion of lust that he had grown to know when that lion was near him. 

A lust to be hunted by Mydei, and a lust to pin that lion down and show him who truly was the prey in their dynamic, even if Mydei was wholly unaware of it. 

──────────────

“Ah! Mydeimos!” Phainon greeted happily, speeding up his walk just the tiniest of bits to catch the elevator that had the lone lion in it - unable to stop the way he was absolutely giddy right now as he moved into that small boxed container with Mydei.

Basking in the way that lion didn’t seem fazed at all, instead only clicking the button to go to the lobby with a quiet exhale. 

.. Was it fate that for once, the person working overtime on the same day as Phainon - was that beautiful lion he was obsessed with..?

“I thought prey were advised to go home early with the recent break-ins.” Mydei absent-mindedly replied, not even sparing a thought to greet Phainon and something about that made his stomach churn in delight.

Phainon didn’t mind the lack of greeting, because at least Mydei seemed to be showing some degree of concern for Phainon’s well being. Adorable, really, considering the way Mydei also lacked such a care for himself. 

Phainon laughed over that, waving his arms dismissively with a lazy shrug, “I had a document due that really couldn’t wait, you know? I wish I had gone home at the same time as those slackers!”

Phainon moved into that elevator a bit too energetically - taking his place in standing beside that lion and practically beaming as he watched the way Mydei gave him a small glance.

.. Phainon could never fully fight down the goosebumps over how Mydei was so large, giant, really. Yet still, somehow, smaller than Phainon was - having to tilt his head the tiniest of bits to look at Phainon in the eyes comfortably. 

“.. Aren’t you the slacker if you waited until the last minute comparatively?” Mydei grumbled out in a less than amused voice, making Phainon instantly move a hand to his own chest - feigning hurt as he gasped loudly over that. 

“What? No! Come on now, Mydei! I'm hardworking, I swear!” Phainon argued back, giving a quiet little laugh as well as he felt his tail twitch in his excitement.

Being this close to Mydei in such a small space..

He smelled good. Intoxicating, really. Phainon found his hands twitching and his heart speeding up as he kept sniffing the air, trying to smell more and more of that lion that was beside him.

“Hm.”

Phainon was content with this. Being trapped in an elevator with Mydei? That was fine, but the greed in his heart couldn’t help himself as he looked at that lion curiously.

“Can I ask an oddly personal question?”

Mydei looked at him for a moment, always being respectful to give whoever had his attention his eye contact - and Phainon adored that. Adored the way his heart sped up out of instincts, feeling as if he was being hunted for sport by this man and could easily lose himself in how much he wanted to be chased by him.

“.. Sure?” Was what Mydei said however, wholly unaware of the way Phainon was practically jittery over just a mere glance being sent his way. 

“Have you ever thought about having children?” “I’ve been thinking about it as of late, and it sounds really nice.”

He had been thinking about it. Too much, really, wondering how adorable their children would be together - it was a rarity for predators and prey to mate and have children, but.. Phainon was rather certain Mydei would be the perfect fit for bearing his children - his own cobalt eyes staring at the shiny metal in front of them before giving a grin to Mydei’s reflection that was looking at his own.

That was enough to make Mydei flicker his eyes away, and Phainon wished he knew what thoughts of emotions had caused such a reaction. 

“.. Rabbits do adore having children, don’t they?” Mydei mindlessly asked, and that was enough to make Phainon scoff over his own instincts. 

It was true, rabbits liked sex a lot - they couldn’t help it, but to Phainon’s credit, he only had Mydei on his mind as of late. The idea of breeding anyone full of his children that wasn’t Mydei was beyond merely disgusting to him at this point; he needed it to be that lion under him and giving him children, or he may actually go insane.

He felt his own foot tap at the floor idly over that, “Haha..”

It took Phainon a few seconds of listening to the whirls of gears and quiet metal of the elevator before Mydei himself spoke again, “I do want children, I’m just not sure if I’m ready yet, nor have I been in a committed relationship for that depth.”

Committed relationship.

Mydei hadn’t been in one of those..? Something about that made Phainon’s heart feel lighter, more free in knowing he could still worm his way into this man’s life, more than a little eager to be that committed partner Mydei was missing. 

“Mm..” Phainon hummed over that, feeling as if he wanted to be that piece more and more as that lion didn’t seem bothered at all by him - not even as he leaned the slightest bit to press his arm into Mydei’s own.

The silence stretched, making Phainon more and more aware of the way Mydei was merely waiting for this to end.

.. Phainon was sure he never wanted this to end, instead continuing that talk; “You would make a good father, I think.”

That seemed to be an easy trick as Mydei’s head shot to tilt to the side, blinking at Phainon slightly before he finally spoke, “Why do you say that?”

“Well,” Phainon started in a sing-song tone - amused as that door opened to their office lobby and allowed both of them out. He couldn’t help but mourn the way Mydei’s scent immediately lessened, but he chased after that lion who immediately walked out of the elevator regardless, “You seem polite.. Patient and nice, aren’t those all good traits for a parent to have?”

“Mm,” Mydei hummed after a moment, eyes flickering a little to seemingly check if Phainon was close enough to hear him as he walked, “Maybe I’m only exhibiting such traits due to us being co-workers.. What was it your friend said? ‘You don’t always know a person’s true self’?”

.. Friend?

That was enough to make Phainon feel sick, anyone who was bringing negative emotions to Mydei and making him leave Phainon’s side early was no friend of his.

“Woah now.. What was it you said..? ‘Friendship’? I am not that mouse’s friend, alright?” Phainon told him, voice coming out of his mouth more clipped and strained than he would have preferred as he moved to Mydei’s side immediately while they walked. Aware of the way golden eyes moved to look at him curiously, brow raised most likely over the annoyance dusting Phainon’s tone. 

“Wow, feisty little bunny.” Mydei teased, and Phainon could only find himself chuckling over that - over how he was much more feisty than how much he was putting on display right now - even if that lion was so blissfully ignorant of it. 

“I am hardly little.” Phainon purred instead, feeling a bit smug as he clenched his hands into fists - still keeping himself close to that man as they both exited the building. Only for Mydei to stop. 

“Right, well my home in this way. I’ll see you around.”

Phainon debated lying, saying the same, saying he lived that way - but he decided to smile instead. Not desiring to rush anything when the chase should be so very savored for the hunter, instead giving that perfect specimen a soft and sweet smile - the one he could only manage for Mydei, anyway. 

“Ah.. Alright, have a nice night, Mydeimos!”

Mydei nodded curtly at that before spinning around from Phainon; “You as well.”

Phainon found himself glued to the pavement as he watched that lion stalk away from him - not nervously checking over his shoulder to see if he was being hunted at all. Never once feeling the ebb of someone leering for him, desiring him in such a carnal way..

All while Phainon was doing just that, eyes staring at that lion as if he was the tastiest prey he had ever seen - for once wondering what blood on his tongue would taste like, that blood that predators adored the taste of and some would go to extreme lengths to illegally get some.

.. Phainon had to worry and throw a look at his own wrist, raising it to turn it and inspect himself - unsure if he just smelled bad to the lion or not with how he hadn’t been gnawed into yet. He wouldn’t even mind if Mydei slipped and looked at him with hunger in his eyes - at least then, he would know he had captured Mydei’s attention.

“Oh! Your hair is up today!” Phainon hummed as he moved closer to Mydei - giving a little smile over the way he found Mydei so pretty like that. A few stray hairs left down, all while the rest was pulled into a small ponytail at the back of his head.

A noticeable thing, considering Mydei hadn’t been facing him at first and was looking downwards - assuredly fixing his coffee just like he always did and Phainon had to mourn the fact he was late to his break. Late to his daily meetings with Mydei, and his chance to talk to the lion.

He truly was behind on all of his work to where he was struggling to even make their schedules line up like normal - Phainon could literally curl up and die the more he thought about it.

“Is that strange?” Mydei asked, still not even turning as Phainon navigated his way to brewing his own coffee - a bit more absentminded about it than normal due to the fact Mydei was here to chat with him.

And oddly, no one else was. Just the lone lion working on his own coffee while that tail remained curled around his leg, fully on display with his back turned to Phainon for once. 

“I’ve never seen you wear it like that..” Phainon noted, and that wasn’t that odd.

Mydei took a moment at that before turning to look at Phainon, his head tilting a little to the side to let Phainon admire the way Mydei still had that braid at the side of his head. Even if his hair was up, that remained - and Phainon almost wanted to ask why he always had that there.

.. He decided not to as Mydei only blinked at him blankly before replying, “Mm, I like it.”

And that was the simplest explanation ever as Mydei brought his cup up to his lips - sipping on it a bit slowly just as he always did. Licking his lips after, just as he always did. Always drawing Phainon’s eyes to it, time and time again.

Phainon had to do his best to tear his eyes away from that sight, an easy task - but getting his mind to focus on other things outside of how much he wanted to feel that tongue, lips, and fangs on and in his skin? Impossibly difficult. 

“I thought predators weren’t fond of showing their necks like that to other predators?” Phainon innocently asked, moving a hand to fiddle with one of his lop-ears. 

Mydei didn’t seem all too bothered with that however, instead a brow slowly raised over the question, “Do you see any predators around besides me?”

To Phainon, that was a trick question, really. To anyone else, the answer was a simple no. Mydeimos was the only predator in the room, but to Phainon.. The bunny who was eager to hunt that lion down, pin him beneath him, and mate with him..

“Myself!” Phainon happily told him, not finding it as a joke at all - yet Mydei scoffed a little over that reply, seemingly finding it amusing as he moved to look at his own cup of coffee. 

“Phainon, you are a rabbit.” Mydei reminded him before taking another sip of his drink - and Phainon sighed over that, shaking his head as he moved to retrieve his own cup. 

He drank it almost black, just with the tiniest hint of sugar dashed in and well - it was adorable how Mydei was so confident in the fact Phainon was no threat towards him. A big lion who had never been hunted down in his life, the idea was almost outrageous. 

“You’re in so much denial that you’re being hunted, Mydeimos..” Phainon told him with a heavy sigh escaping his lips - all while moving his own cup to sip at it idly. Always preferring it to be piping hot, and well..

He couldn’t help but feel like he had to do at least something idly while Mydei so blatantly seemed to find his words amusing. 

It would be almost insulting, if he blamed Mydei at all for that reaction. 

“.. By a rabbit? I don’t think your dull fangs will do much.” Mydei chuckled a little as he said those words - and that was enough to make Phainon so painfully aware that the lion meant them. He genuinely believed Phainon was utterly harmless to him, and that was just as amusing for Phainon as it was for Mydei!

Phainon had to laugh as well, shaking his head over how silly that vulnerable lion was acting; “You would be surprised! What if I bite you and just don’t let go?”

“Are you saying I wouldn’t be strong enough to tear you off of me?” Mydei asked, a quirk in his lips that was the smallest of smiles - and for once, Phainon could see it. A flicker of amusement in his eyes, the way he was looking Phainon up and down to measure his warmth, Phainon could see it all.

His interest in Phainon for once. 

So beautifully on display, that Phainon felt lust coiling into him, almost feeling a sneaking thought in his mind - so simple that it made Phainon feel jittery when he considered it.

Mydei wanted to be hunted, to be chased. At least, that was what it seemed like to Phainon as he watched the behaviors of that man seemingly change - eyes looking more and more playful as the conversation continued. 

“I’d make sure it’s not easy,” Phainon told him, or well, he was more like promising Mydei as he gave a small wink to the lion,  “After all, I can’t have my prey escaping me, can I?”

“If our hybrid species were swapped, I think I would need to tell HR about this.” Mydei chuckled a little quietly, but Phainon couldn’t take his eyes off of him. Watching the way that cute little lion tail was swaying behind him back and forth - almost lashing with his new interest in the bunny and that wonder towards being hunted.

It was so painfully cute that Phainon found himself fighting the urge to convince him into the bathroom for a quickie - but he most likely would never go for it. 

Thus, Phainon had to scoff as well with a roll of his eyes; “True, true. But you’re a lion, and I’m just a little bunny. Surely my teeth can’t actually hurt you?”

Phainon was joking - he knew fully well he could break that man’s flesh if he got the chance to have his fun with him, bite down and never let go of him. Stake a claim on that man and let everyone know he was mates with an innocent little bunny, having people assume he's dominant all while Phainon pushed him onto the bed nightly.

His teeth absolutely could do more than just hurt that pretty lion hybrid, he knew that much about himself.

“Besides.. This is the first time I’ve ever seen you uncurl your tail, you know..?” Phainon pointed out with a little nervous laugh, eyes still watching it as it froze its instinctual swaying with Mydei’s riled up emotions, “Is this talk of me chasing you and making you into my prey.. Exciting, Mydeimos?”

Mydei’s smile seemed to drop at that - eyes flicking to Phainon to stare at him with such a blank expression that Phainon could only call it enamoring when those golden eyes were so wide; “My.. Tail?”

“Mhm, you’re letting it sway..  Did you not notice?” Phainon asked coolly, almost innocently as he took another swig of his drink - eyes never daring to move away from Mydei as he watched every single thing that lion did now. 

Mydei took a moment to digest those words before dipping his head away - face growing slightly red as if he was getting embarrassed by it; “.. My mistake.”

Phainon found himself licking his lips to taste his coffee, all while staring at that red hue on Mydei’s face - taking in the way Mydei was so very beautiful when red in the face. It made him want to see how much of his body could turn such a lovely color to rival those tattoos of his. 

“Awh, but it’s so cute? Do you enjoy the idea of being hunted for once, Mydei?” Phainon asked innocently, but he fully knew it was a loaded question - at least, for him considering how much he wanted that lion hybrid to be chased. To feel hunted down, to want the thrill of being preyed on for once in his life..

“It’s an amusing thought,” Mydei admitted, and that was more than enough to spur Phainon’s delusions forward as the lion huffed out a laugh and shook his head, moving to instead leave; “But a foolish one. I’m not exactly someone that would make easy prey, and my break is over. See you around.”

“Haha.. I like the thought of it too, you know! Bye bye, Mydeimos!” Phainon chirped as that lion walked away without even looking back over that. 

Phainon couldn’t help but stand there and stare after that man - eyes watching the way his tail slowly wrapped back around himself. Coiling almost protectively and Phainon now found that.. Endearing, in a way.

Now with the knowledge that the lion’s tail could uncoil if he became excited, a cute thing to learn, for sure. And one that Phainon found himself only endlessly wanting to abuse as he slowly moved his own cup of coffee to his lips. Humming a little to himself over how badly he wanted to truly ruin that hybrid.
